# Customer data retention policy (fixture)

## Scope

Records are kept in the system that created them and are not copied to personal storage, shared drives or email folders. Each business unit names a records owner who answers questions about the records it holds and who approves any exception. ## Requests from customers

A customer may ask for a copy of the personal data held about them. The copy is sent within thirty days of the request.
